subject: How many hours?
author: Nakard
body: Man you played that a lot, did you have a job, a life or what? I did a lot of hour over all 5 games, but no that much. I spent most of my time on takedown and revenge on the xbox, i played on takedown on the PS2 for a good 100 hours or so, but it started to play-up and the network online was not cool, so it flew a outa window. Part -time Burner now compared to suffur.
